name: Molly's Marvelous Photos
source:
Molly is a flower with a list of things she wants to take pictures of throughout the day.

From morning till night, can you help Molly capture everything?

[From [url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/mollys-marvelous-photos-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莫莉是一朵花，上面列出了她全天想要拍照的事物清单。

从早到晚，你能帮助莫莉捕捉到一切吗？

[来自[url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/mollys-marvelous-photos-demo]itch.io[/url]]
